statement: Let n = len(plants). Let 0 = b_0 < b_1 < ... < b_m < b_{m+1} = n be the unique increasing sequence such that: (a) for every j with 0 <= j <= m, sum_{i=b_j}^{b_{j+1}-1} plants[i] <= capacity; and (b) for every j with 0 <= j < m, sum_{i=b_j}^{b_{j+1}} plants[i] > capacity. The function returns a result r and r = n + 2 * (sum_{j=1}^{m} b_j), where the sum is 0 if m = 0.
preconditions: Let n = len(plants). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= plants[i] <= 1000000; capacity <= 1000000000; and max_{0 <= i < n} plants[i] <= capacity. All indices are 0-based.

preconditions: Let n = len(plants). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= plants[i] <= 1000000; capacity <= 1000000000; and max_{0 <= i < n} plants[i] <= capacity. All indices are 0-based.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = n * n if and only if for every i with 1 <= i < n, plants[i-1] + plants[i] > capacity.
preconditions: Let n = len(plants). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= plants[i] <= 1000000; capacity <= 1000000000; and max_{0 <= i < n} plants[i] <= capacity. All indices are 0-based.

statement: Let S = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} plants[i] and let m = ceil(S / capacity) - 1. Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= n + m * (m + 1).
preconditions: Let n = len(plants). The input satisfies 1 <= n <= 1000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= plants[i] <= 1000000; capacity <= 1000000000; and max_{0 <= i < n} plants[i] <= capacity. All indices are 0-based.

statement: For every i with 1 <= i < n, if plants[i] = capacity, then whenever the function returns a result r, r >= n + 2 * i.
